Over-priced and Under-whelming Thai place!
Feb 2016 • Solo
I went by myself and had Thai iced tea, yam woon sen and beef massaman - all very basic Thai dishes. This is 1 of 2 locations of a popular local upscale and over-priced fusion Thai place. Offerings are many of the staples of Thai cuisine you would see in any westernised style restaurant - but strangely over sauced, under-seasoned, under-whelming and over-priced as well.

I paid 435,000VND for myself at lunch on a Saturday afternoon, this included a ~5% service charge and VAT (tax). This comes out to almost $20 USD for lunch, almost as much or more than I would pay in San Francisco. Strangely they stuffed about 4-5 business cards of other places (their own maybe?) in the check presenter when I paid for the bill. 

Server did well, he probably saved the experience. 

This was my 2nd. place to try Thai food in HCMC, both very disappointing. 

Very loud on the 2nd. floor when I was here.
